integrity: The main claim is supported by a complete analytical proof in RESULT.md. verify_selection.py contains corroborating finite numerical checks; its finite output is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-capacity closed compartments, strictly positive temporary conflict/recruitment/recovery rates, nonnegative regular conflict rate, and initial regular population within vacancies. No empirical validation or joint strong-recruitment/weak-conflict limit; scaled clock not uniform to zero.
title: Singular vacancy saturation and a slow extinction clock in a four-compartment flow
